en.title: The Great River of Silver Particles: Legacy of Heat and the Market of Oblivion
en.premise: The 'silver particles' obtained at the cost of magic's end nourish civilization with heat, yet they feed upon the precious memories of humanity. Amidst the rise of the steam engine, people scramble toward the 'Memory Market' in a desperate attempt to buy back what they have lost. Following the footsteps of former heroes Alistair, Elena, and Silas, nameless commoners and a new generation of engineers clash over the very essence of humanity being eroded by technological progress. Will this heat-drenched new world bring true salvation, or lead humanity toward a new, hollow void?

zh.title: 银粒子之大河：热之遗产与遗忘之市
zh.premise: 以魔法的终结为代价换来的“银色粒子”，在用热量滋养文明的同时，也在吞噬着人们珍贵的记忆。在蒸汽机兴起的阴影下，人们为了买回失去的记忆，纷纷奔向“记忆交易市场”。追随着昔日英雄阿里斯泰尔、埃琳娜与赛拉斯的足迹，无名的庶民与新一代的技术人员们，围绕着因技术进步而逐渐丧失的人性，展开了激烈的冲突。这个充满热量的崭新世界，究竟会带来真正的救赎，还是会走向一片新的虚无？
